name: glass-code-block
title: Glass Code Block
description: A frosted-glass code editor window with a small regex colouring (plain spans, no highlighter library) and a line-by-line stagger reveal. Transparent, so it composites over any background.
useWhen: A landing or hero scene needs an animated code backdrop that reads as a premium dev tool.
You want to showcase a snippet with styled editor chrome and no interactive narrative.
avoidWhen: The code must be visibly typed character by character: use a terminal or typewriter block.
The panel should be camera-tracked: use glass-code-walk.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Code
variables.description: Source text, one line per row.

variables.label: Width
variables.description: Window width in pixels on a 1280x720 frame.

variables.label: Height
variables.description: Window height in pixels on a 1280x720 frame.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Frames between one line and the next (30 fps).

variables.label: Glass colour
variables.description: CSS colour of the glass panel.

variables.label: Aura
variables.description: Draw a slow colour glow behind the glass so the blur has something to refract.
